Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was
changing lanes. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the
lumbar strain diagnosed at intake. Over the course of 23 visits, treatment followed a
conventional progression of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and graded return to
activity, and the frequency of visits tapered steadily as symptoms resolved. Imaging
and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient
reports a remote, small strain to the same region many years ago, which resolved
completely without residual limitation and did not require ongoing care. Billed
services correspond to the documented visits, with no repeated charges identified.
Current status shows near-full range of motion, minimal tenderness, and independence
in daily activities. Continued self-directed exercise is recommended, with follow-up
as needed.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
